summary: A way of slicing up what the organisation serves, such as region or product line, and the slices under it.
definition: A segment is a way of slicing up what the organisation serves, so a gap can say where it was found and a KPI can be broken down the same way: by region, by depot, by product line, by holding size. Define the slicing first, as a segment with no parent (Region), then each slice under it (the northern region). Both gaps and KPIs name the same segments, so a finding and its measure always cut the work the same way. A segment is not a beneficiary group (people the work is for), not a team (who does the work), not a label (a free cut nobody planned), and not a period of time (the reporting cycle's job).

/spec/parent.guide: The slicing this is one slice of (Region, for the northern region), or the broader slice it sits inside. Leave it empty for the slicing itself. A segment can never sit under itself, directly or further up, and such a parent is refused on save. When the slicing does not exist yet, define it first.

poor.why: A team, not a segment: the parent is the dimension the slice belongs to, here Depot.

/spec/description.guide: What falls inside this slice and what does not, precisely enough that two people counting it would agree, including how a borderline case is counted.
good: Which collection depot produce passed through. Every depot in the network is a value; produce collected in the field is counted against the depot it was taken to.
Which line produce belongs to. A crate is counted against one line only, by what it mostly holds.

poor.why: Does not say where a region's boundary comes from, so two people could count a holding differently.
Says why it matters, not what falls inside it.

/metadata/name.guide: The name, as people say it and as lists show it.

Gap:/spec/segments.ask: Which gaps were observed in this slice? Each gap lists the segments its evidence covers.
Gap:/spec/segments.ifNone: Nothing has to be defined first: a segment may be declared before any gap names it. When a gap's evidence covers this slice, name the segment on the gap.

KPI:/spec/disaggregations.ask: Which KPIs are broken down by this dimension? Each KPI lists the dimensions it is split by.
KPI:/spec/disaggregations.ifNone: Leave it: only a dimension, a segment with no parent, is a disaggregation, and a KPI names it when its source can report the split.
